text_block_list.text:
I go with Марузенски to welcome the
new year at
a shrine.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of taking a drive on New
Year's
Day since the roads are usually
clear...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
But it just doesn't feel like New Year's
until you
go visit a shrine!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
It's the perfect place to make a
resolution for the
year and pray for my
goal to be achieved!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, my goal is to participate in lots of
fun
races!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
That's why I have to be more active than
ever and
become someone that others
can look up to!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
choice_data_list: I'll help you every step of the way!

text_block_list.text:
I know you will, Trainer! I'm counting on
you.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I know you will, Trainer! I'm counting on
you.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
So, what exactly should we be focusing
on in
order to achieve this goal?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
choice_data_list:
We should work on fundamentals, like physical
conditioning.
We should set a well-balanced training regimen.

We should focus on making your best skills
even better.

text_block_list.text:
"The best ability is availability," they
say. Honing
your skills means nothing if
you're not healthy
enough to be on the
track.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'll try to take care of myself
better than
ever before!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I see! So you're saying a balanced
workout is key
to taking it up a notch!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm on the job! I'll keep this in
mind while
training.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
If we're talking about my best skills, I'd
say my
driving is second to none!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Psych! You were talking about my running skills, right?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'll try to keep that in mind while
I'm
training.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Well, now that that's decided, let's finish
up here!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
With that settled, let's finish up here,
shall we?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
All right then, let's finish up here, shall
we?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Whew... Now that we've visited a shrine,
it's
finally time to start the new year.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Марузенски!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year! I hope you have a
happy and
healthy year!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Yeah, Happy New Year!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year right back at you! ☆
Are you all
going to the shrine too?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
That's right! I know it's like this every
year, but
there are so many folks here I
feel I'll get lost!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Your dislike of crowds explains why
you're always
so quick to break away
from the pack in races!
Hehe!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, did you know? These two
are the
bomb!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, did you know? These two
are the
bomb!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Ever since their debut, they've been
making
names for themselves. People
are calling them
members of the
"Ultimate Generation"!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Ehehe... You're making me blush.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
As your senior, it makes me so happy to
see you
cuties doing so well! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
We've grown so much thanks to the
friendly
competition we have between
us.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
We recognize each other's drive, and
that pushes
us to keep trying to surpass
one another.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Even if we lose, it just makes us
want to win
more the next time, right?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
And it wasn't only my classmates who
lifted me
up.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
This year, I'm trying to surpass the
person I've
watched and admired since
before my debut...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Is that... by any chance...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Yes, Марузенски. Would you be willing
to run a
race with me?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Wow! I can't believe I'm already reaping
the
benefits of visiting the shrine so
soon!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! G-Grass, are you sure about this?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure I'm not good enough to
face off
against Maruzen yet...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Well, you won't know for sure until you
try, right?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Also, like Grass said, it's great to have
someone
to compete against.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Having someone to compare yourself to,

someone to encourage and be
encouraged by... I
believe that's what
keeps us running.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: To encourage each other...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
It would be such a waste to avoid
challenging
each other!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Grass, let's use this race to raise one
another
up—to the highest of heights!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Let's! The Yasuda Kinen is in June—I'll
challenge
you there.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to it!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Goodness... Grass is amazing...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Heheh! ♪ This year looks like it's going
to be a
blast!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
How could I not be! Running with the
newer
students is going to be so much
fun!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Oh, by the way, have you decided what
race
we're going to shoot for next?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I'm going to run with Grass in June, but
that
doesn't mean I won't be racing until
then, right?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
She wants to have all the fun she can
this year, so
it's only natural that we
challenge some of the
toughest races
out there...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Let's shoot for the Osaka Hai!

text_block_list.text: Oooh! The biggest event of the spring!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna kick it into full gear
beneath
the blooming cherry trees!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
With our next race set, a new year with

Марузенски begins.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
